primary_hypothesis.statement: At horizon H-10, volatility regime features (VOL_ZSCORE) produce Spearman IC > 0 against forward excess returns, and this IC is greater than the baseline IC without volatility features

secondary_hypothesis.statement: At horizon H-20, volatility regime features (VOL_ZSCORE) produce Spearman IC > 0 against forward excess returns, and this IC is greater than the baseline IC without volatility features

hypothesis_classification.rationale: H-10 is primary per mechanism (intermediate horizon); H-20 is secondary for replication. Both must show positive incremental IC for full confirmation.

falsification_criteria: Primary IC significant but negative sign in >50% of OOS periods
H-10 and H-20 show opposite signs

exploratory_evidence_summary.interpretation: EXPLORATORY ONLY — not confirmatory evidence. Used solely to calibrate thresholds.
